name: Foreign Exchange Trade Capture Report Request V 02
definition: Scope|The ForeignExchangeTradeCaptureReportRequest message is sent by a trading member to the trading system for inquiry of trade capture report. |Usage|The request is sent by the trading member to the trading system to inquire trade capture report. |Note a capture request could be rejected.

QueryOrderStatus.name: Query Order Status
QueryOrderStatus.definition: Range of the trade for the inquire.

QueryType.name: Query Type
QueryType.definition: Specifies the inquiry type of the data.

QueryByPeriod.name: Query By Period
QueryByPeriod.definition: Indicates whether the request is query trade for a period of time.

QueryTradeIdentification.name: Query Trade Identification
QueryTradeIdentification.definition: States the identification of the trade which the trading member inquires.

QueryEndIdentification.name: Query End Identification
QueryEndIdentification.definition: Identifies the end of the request result.

QueryParameterValue.name: Query Parameter Value
QueryParameterValue.definition: Specifies the inquiry value of the parameter.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

QueryPeriodAndTradeIdentification1Rule.definition: Either QueryTradeIdentification or QueryPeriod may be present, but not both.

QueryPeriodAndTradeIdentification2Rule.definition: If QueryByPeriod is "false" or "0" (No), then QueryTradeIdentification must be present. If QueryByPeriod is "true" or "1" (Yes), then QueryPeriod must be present.
